stories.title: NVIDIA, IBM, Fermilab join hands to advance quantum computing research
stories.description: NVIDIA, IBM and Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory (Fermilab) have joined hands to develop a modular quantum computing codesign platform, combining quantum processors with accelerated computing systems to advance research into next-generation quantum computers and their scientific applications.
